lines.text: evolution does not design — it accumulates accidents that happen to survive
lines.note: evolution without a designer still needs a fitness function it cannot evolve: the author moves from the geometry to the gradient, and the ninety percent culled each generation vanish without a name.

note_src.quote: The author did not leave. The author moved from the geometry to the gradient.

lines.text: a tree does not know its shape — it only knows which direction has light
lines.note: a tree that only knows which direction has light cannot supply the light: the attractor cloud poses the shape from outside and dies on contact, so the branch is a record of what it consumed.

note_src.quote: The tree grows by devouring what drew it forward.

lines.text: connectivity is not gradual — below the threshold nothing connects
lines.note: the lattice cannot set its own density: p is a const at 0.4, comfortably past p_c, so the map built to show a system deciding has only ever shown it deciding one way.

note_src.quote: every player who ever met this lattice met a lattice that was always going to connect

lines.text: an organic space is not designed from outside
Interactive visualization of branching growth patterns and algorithmic plant generation
lines.note: the comparison needs rules and noise to be one spectrum, and the map can only build two wings: the tree readable fork by fork, the terrain with no genealogy, the hybrid a missing ontology rather than a missing artifact.

note_src.quote: The hybrid that the intent.md identifies as a gap is not just a missing artifact — it is a missing ontology.

pearls.edge: the bricoleur cannot supply its own material: every rebuild is made of what your strikes knocked loose, so its morphology is a function of your attention and the loop has no termination condition.

edge_src.quote: A learner who keeps striking the golem's legs produces a golem that rebuilds more legs

lines.text: VR-scale walkable maze with recursive backtracking generation
lines.note: the contrast needs a dividing wall neither algorithm carved — the one frankly authored thing in the room — and from inside either side the difference it exists to show is gone: the body cannot tell rule from accident.

note_src.quote: the dividing wall is pure intention: a curatorial gesture that organizes two algorithms into an exhibit

lines.text: a cave is not empty space — it is the record of everything that was removed
a membrane is a boundary that is also a surface
lines.note: accumulation gives the shape and cannot give the milieu: the mound is no landform, the dome a surface and not a shelter, the membrane's fifty shells have never borne load — architecture with the architecture removed.

note_src.quote: architecture with the architecture removed — geometry that resembles built form but has never borne load, shed rain, or sheltered a body

lines.text: Procedural mound built from stacked cubes — layered cellular logic deposits cubes where conditions permit
a boolean shelter is the interference pattern of solids that are no longer present
the mandala is not emergent. A fragment is computed and the rest is copied — and this
lines.note: the mandala needs a stencil it did not compute: twenty-five cells drawn and tiled four hundred times, so each reflection axis subtracts entropy and the intricacy is borrowed from the viewer, not earned by the rule.

note_src.quote: A stencil is cut, and the rest is repetition.

lines.text: a rhizome has no beginning and no end — it is always in the middle
